item.title: Rainbow Ball deliver record donation to Football V Homophobia
item.description: This season goals scored with the EFL PUMA Rainbow Ball have hit an all-time high that sees PUMA donating a record £24,900 to Football v Homophobia (FvH). This figure is more than double last season’s total and marks the most successful year of the initiative to date. This figure builds on the momentum of previous years. item.title: Hutchinson snatches late point for Cheltenham in League Two thriller
item.description: Isaac Hutchinson’s stoppage-time equaliser earned Cheltenham Town a Sky Bet League Two draw in a topsy‑turvy contest with Barrow, who climbed out of the bottom two despite being denied late on. Cheltenham made the early breakthrough when Josh Davison converted Hutchinson’s low cross following a fine diagonal pass from James Wilson in the 15th minute — the on‑loan Tranmere Rovers forward’s first goal for the Club. item.title: Oxford earn crucial Deepdale win to climb out of relegation zone
item.description: Oxford United secured a vital victory at Deepdale as they moved out of the Sky Bet Championship relegation places with a 3-1 win over Preston North End. The U’s made the perfect start when Michal Helik fired them ahead inside five minutes, capitalising on some hesitant defending. Preston responded quickly, though, as Milutin Osmajic levelled in a frantic opening spell, with both early goals owing something to defensive lapses. item.title: Young Saints Foundation participants step behind the scenes on matchday
item.description: Young people from Saints Foundation’s secondary school projects were given a unique behind-the-scenes insight into life on a professional matchday as part of Southampton Football Club’s recent Charity Matchdays. Participants were invited to shadow members of staff from across the Club, providing them with first-hand experience of the wide range of roles required to deliver a successful matchday at St Mary’s Stadium.
